req.title: Retrieve player by squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/squadNumber/{squadNumber} with the player wearing that squad number.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} retrieves a player by their squad number. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — a mid-range squad number that exists (squad 10, Messi) verifying exact payload fields; (2) NEG — a squad number that does not exist returns exactly HTTP 404; (3) BVA boundary-low — squad number 1 (lowest in fixture) returns correct player; (4) BVA boundary-high — squad number 26 (highest in fixture) returns correct player; (5) NEG — squad number 0 (below minimum fixture value) returns 404; (6) NEG — squad number 27 (above maximum fixture value) returns 404; (7) EP — a non-integer path segment returns 422 (FastAPI path validation). Each test asserts exact status codes and exact payload field values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Squad number 10 (Lionel Messi) exists in the database
expected: Response body contains exact player data for Messi: id, firstName, lastName, squadNumber=10, position, team, league, starting11
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Andrés'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'RW'
    assert body['team'] == 'Paris Saint-Germain'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == True
    assert body['id'] == 'acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c'
